title: Wolf Companion
short: Private, on-device AI companion (PWA) that runs LLM inference in-browser via WebGPU.
tech: WebLLM, WebGPU, PWA, Firebase Auth, Firestore

adlc.aim: Privacy-first conversational assistant with optional account sync and offline capability.
adlc.data: Small calibration prompts and local conversation history stored per-user in Firestore; no outbound telemetry.
adlc.develop: Integrated WebLLM runtime, implemented model caching and PWA manifest + service worker for offline shell.
adlc.deploy: Deployed as GitHub Pages demo; first-load model download UX documented.
adlc.learn: Monitor first-load times and WebGPU compatibility; next: progressive download and smaller model variants for low-end devices.

title: SentinelAI
short: AI SOC alert triage: explains alerts, auto-resolves low-risk items, escalates unclear/risky ones with audit logging.
tech: FastAPI, React, Supabase Auth, Gemini (LLM), SSE, SQLite audit log

adlc.aim: Reduce analyst workload by auto-resolving noise and providing explainable decisions with traceability.
adlc.data: Realistic JSON alert feeds and simulated MCP connector; schema designed for audit logging and reproducibility.
adlc.develop: Server-side LLM analysis with backend safety rules; SSE streaming to frontend; persistent audit log of prompt/response and model fingerprint.
adlc.deploy: Local Docker Compose for dev; Render Blueprint recommended for production; planned Wazuh connector for live SIEM ingestion.
adlc.learn: Tune decision thresholds based on analyst feedback; track false auto-resolutions and MTTR.

title: Legal LLM Quantizer
short: On-prem Docker pipeline to 4-bit quantize large LLMs for compliance-sensitive legal deployments with audit logging.

adlc.aim: Produce auditable, quantized model artifacts for law firms where data can't leave infrastructure.
adlc.data: Calibration corpus built from firm legal documents (contracts, statutes) to preserve domain accuracy during quantization.
adlc.develop: GPTQ calibration pass, config-driven quantization, SHA256 hashing for chain-of-custody, optional GGUF conversion for serving.
adlc.deploy: Docker Compose with an air-gap option; outputs stored in models/quantized and logs/.
adlc.learn: Run post-quant accuracy tests on legal evaluation sets; keep audit logs for reproducibility.

title: Wolf SaaS Dashboard
short: Stylized full-stack streaming AI SaaS dashboard for ultra-low-latency token streaming demos.
tech: React, FastAPI, Docker Compose, Ollama/local LLMs

adlc.aim: Deliver ultra-low-latency streaming chat for SaaS demos and prototypes.
adlc.data: Integration with local inference engine inputs; configuration to connect to running model engines.
adlc.develop: Streaming token delivery, system persona panels, cancel/abort controls, and history memory for context continuity.
adlc.deploy: Docker Compose for local testing; guidance for LAN/mobile access and security token gating.
adlc.learn: Instrument stream latency and resource usage; iterate UX for mobile responsiveness and cold-start behavior.

title: TriFiber
short: Full-stack health SaaS (React + FastAPI) with Docker and Render Blueprint deployment instructions.

adlc.aim: Prototype a consumer-facing evidence-led nutrition platform with a deployable stack.
adlc.data: Product data, quiz inputs, batch lab records; used to generate personalized routines and product pages.
adlc.develop: Multi-service Dockerfile, Vite frontend, and FastAPI backend with API docs and HTML preview routes.
adlc.deploy: Render Blueprint for 1-click cloud deployment or Docker image for local testing.
adlc.learn: Monitor deployments, health checks, and conversion funnel through demo analytics.

title: Pandemic ETL Project
short: ETL demo extracting John Hopkins COVID-19 data, cleaning, and loading into a Postgres DB for analysis.

adlc.aim: Build a reproducible ETL pipeline to analyze COVID-19 cases for March 2020.
adlc.data: CSV series from John Hopkins / Humdata; transformations included date normalization and daily increase calculation.
adlc.develop: Pandas-based cleaning functions, melt/date transforms, and Postgres loading via SQLAlchemy/engine.
adlc.deploy: Local Postgres for analytics; notebooks used for EDA and SQL queries.
adlc.learn: Use results to drive visualizations; adapt pipeline for scheduled ingestion if needed.

title: BigDataProject
short: General-purpose Big Data ETL starter showing extract → transform → load patterns and sample notebooks.

adlc.aim: Demonstrate an end-to-end ETL pipeline for large datasets and provide examples for reproducible ingestion.
adlc.data: Open datasets and CSV/JSON telemetry samples; config-driven input/output paths.
adlc.develop: Modular scripts for extract, transform, and load; examples for scaling with Spark commented in code.
adlc.deploy: Run as scheduled jobs (cron / Airflow) or containerized worker; unit tests with pytest included.
adlc.learn: Add monitoring for data quality and column drift; integrate with orchestration tools for production runs.

title: SoniLaw Visitor Demo
short: HTML/CSS/JS prototype of a visitor check-in flow with camera photo capture and returning-visitor autofill simulation.

adlc.aim: Prototype the interaction and UX of a visitor registration flow before backend integration.
adlc.data: Simulated in-browser lookup and sample phone numbers for returning visitor flow.
adlc.develop: No backend — client-side camera capture, reference number generation, and form interactions for UX validation.
adlc.deploy: Hosted via GitHub Pages; used as a design artifact to wire to a Python/FastAPI + Supabase backend later.
adlc.learn: Collect user feedback on flow and add real persistence & security when wiring to backend.

title: Simple Linear Regression
short: Educational Jupyter notebook exploring simple linear regression for a salary-hike prediction exercise.

adlc.aim: Build and evaluate a simple linear regression model for Salary_hike prediction using EDA and transformations.
adlc.data: Small tabular dataset with salary and related features; used for correlation analysis and model selection.
adlc.develop: EDA, visualization, correlation analysis, model building and testing in notebook form.
adlc.deploy: Notebook artifacts for teaching/demo; no production serving.
adlc.learn: Document findings and next steps for regularization, cross-validation, and feature engineering.
